headline: A new version of Wyrm
author: OM Rajput
releaseNotes: Your settings live in your account: log in on any phone and they come back.
Play upright: portrait mode with its own layout, steering with the arrow.
8 new arena floors, including true Black.
Performance modes (Auto, Balanced, Performance) and an FPS limit; Wyrm runs cooler.
Your last run in the lobby, and a red dot on the minimap where you went down.
Best for you: the arena picker puts the lowest-ping arena on top.
The joystick knob follows your snake; assist laser in joystick mode.
Live notifications, red badges that lead to what's new, formatted messages.
New voice rooms, a new Foods page, background size adjusted over the arena.
Fixed: drops right after spawning with a custom skin, a crash when switching performance modes, What's new on every start.
